main.description: A named, public stretch of route for one sport group, which consenting athletes' activities are matched against (app.activitytracker.feed.getActivitySegments). Public: stored only in its creator's repo, never in a space. The AppView computes its length from line, indexes it only when that is at least its sport group's minimum (500 m for ride, 200 m for the others) and at most 50 km, and ignores a copy found in any space. Athletes' segments are keyed by TID; the segment importer's are keyed by the id of the candidate they were published from (app.activitytracker.importer.defs#candidate).

sport.description: The sport group whose activities can match it. A segment whose group the AppView doesn't know isn't indexed.

kind.description: Run (the default when absent): a stretch athletes travel under their own power or by gravity. Lift: a ski lift, its line from the bottom station to the top, only in the alpine group and only from the segment importer; it is matched like a run but never ranked, named or counted for Mayors. A segment whose kind the AppView doesn't know isn't indexed.

line.description: The segment from start to end as an encoded polyline at precision 6 (1e-6 degrees), at least two positions.

source.description: Where the line came from: an athlete's activity, OpenStreetMap or a public agency's dataset.

license.description: The licence of the line's data, as an SPDX identifier such as CC0-1.0 or ODbL-1.0.

attribution.description: Who to credit for the line's data, such as a public agency ("USDA Forest Service"). Shown only for agency segments; the AppView drops a blank or over-long one.

oneWay.description: Its sport group may travel the line only in the direction it is drawn, by the rules of the data it came from (segments/segment-direction), such as an OpenStreetMap oneway:bicycle tag. Absent means false. Only the segment importer's are honoured: the AppView serves segmentView.oneWay for no other account's segment.

climb.description: Whether the line, travelled in the direction it is drawn, climbs or descends as its trail does (segments/segment-direction): its own clear climb, else its trail's, judged from terrain. Absent says nothing; the apps judge from elevation then. Only the segment importer's are honoured: the AppView serves segmentView.climb for no other account's segment.

trail.description: What the line's source data says about its trail, such as its surface and difficulty (segments/trail-attributes). Only the segment importer's are honoured: the AppView serves segmentView.trail for no other account's segment.

derivedFrom.description: The activity the line was traced from, if any.
